title: MCP server installation got less dramatic
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: MCP installs became sturdier and four community-built projects landed in the showcase.

The MCP server package and docs were refreshed, while install failures were addressed with an AbortController polyfill. Connecting pollinations to MCP-compatible tools should now involve fewer dependency-era surprises.

The community project list now includes pollinations-tg-bot, toai.chat, IMyself AI, and TeekGenAI—more examples of people building useful, strange, and internet-shaped things with the API.
